# Copilot Instructions

Use the repository skill file below as the default Spring Boot guidance for this project:

- `.github/copilot/skills/github-awesome-copilot-skills-java-springboot-skill-md.md`

## Project-specific defaults

- Prefer concise, production-ready Java and Spring Boot code.
- Keep REST contracts stable (`BookRequest`, `BookResponse`, `ErrorResponse`).
- Add or update tests when behavior changes (`JUnit`, `Cucumber` where applicable).
- Avoid introducing breaking package changes unless explicitly requested.
- If multiple approaches are possible, prefer readability and testability.
